title: Trigger bounded brain gap discovery from failures and completed work
goal: Wire gap discovery into production events: failed user intents, recurring tool/model failures, acceptance/CI regressions, completed task verification and explicit audit requests. Re-evaluate unmet roadmap mastery targets after related work closes. Debounce repeated events and apply configurable token/spend/time and queue limits so discovery cannot amplify incidents or generate endless task chains. Use current working powerful brain selection, record unavailable-brain state and resume eligible discovery after recovery without duplicate tasks. Keep operational transient issues distinct from actionable software gaps. Hermetic event-path tests cover burst failures, restart, closed-task residual gaps and budget exhaustion. Implement nonzero tests named brain_gap_triggers_* exercising production wiring.
